newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria harvests record 4.9 mln T cereals -premier.
newsitem.headline: Algeria harvests record 4.9 mln T cereals -premier.

text.p: Algeria harvested a record 4.9 million tonnes of cereals in the 1995/1996 season, beating the 3.6 million tonnes record set in 1990/91, the country's Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia was quoted as saying on Thursday.

"The cereals harvest reached 49 million quintals (4.9 million tonnes) in 1995/96 instead of 46 million quintals (4.6 million tonnes) as was announced previously," said Ouyahia, quoted by the Algerian state-run radio.
Algeria harvested only 2.13 million tonnes in the 1994/95 season.
Ouyahia announced the new figure as he addressed a farmers' union leadership meeting in Tipaza, 60 km west of Algiers.
Algeria's agriculture ministry said in a statement released on August 14 that cereal production was 46 quintals in 1995/96.
The radio, quoting Ouayhia, gave no reason for the change in figures.
